desc_group_action: Taking, gaining, or losing actions — extra actions, immediate actions, and cards whose ability performs a fight, evade, investigate, move, parley, or engage.
desc_group_aoo: Attacks of opportunity — actions and plays that avoid provoking them.
desc_group_attach: Cards that attach to an asset, enemy, investigator, or location.
desc_group_auto: Automatic results with no skill test — automatically succeed, or automatically evade.
desc_group_buff: Lasting benefits on you or your assets — enemies cannot attack or engage you, or extra health and sanity.
desc_group_cancel: Cancelling things before they happen — attacks, damage, horror, treacheries, chaos tokens, and more.
desc_group_chaos: The chaos bag — revealing, ignoring, changing, sealing, predicting, and adding or removing tokens.
desc_group_clue: Clues — discovering them (extra, or at other locations) and placing them.
desc_group_commit: Committing cards to skill tests — to other investigators, from outside your hand, and limits on committing.
desc_group_condition: Effects that only work, or scale, at a threshold — resources, sanity, cards in hand, clues, or copies.
desc_group_cost: What an ability costs — exhausting, discarding, spending uses or resources, taking damage or horror — and discounts.
desc_group_damage: Dealing damage — extra damage, spreading it, redirecting it, or dealing it to investigators.
desc_group_deck: Decks — drawing, searching, looking at the top, discarding from them, and shuffling.
desc_group_discard: Cards discarding themselves from play, and discarding treacheries already in play.
desc_group_discard_pile: Getting cards back out of the discard pile, into your hand or your deck.
desc_group_doom: Doom — placing it, removing it, moving it, stalling the agenda, or caring how much there is.
desc_group_duration: How long an effect lasts — until the end of the turn, phase, or round, or until the next time something happens.
desc_group_encounter: Encounter cards — handing yours to another investigator, or blanking an enemy or treachery.
desc_group_enemy: Enemies — engaging them, restricting or hindering them, getting rid of them, and using their printed values.
desc_group_exile: Exile — cards removed from your deck when used, bought back with experience.
desc_group_gain: Gaining or moving resources, and giving enemies or cards a keyword such as aloof, retaliate, or fast.
desc_group_hand_size: Maximum hand size, and effects that care how many cards are in your hand.
desc_group_heal: Healing damage or horror — from you, another investigator, an ally, or the card itself.
desc_group_location: Locations — moving investigators, enemies, and clues; shroud; connections; and effects scoped to your or a connecting location.
desc_group_multiclass: Payoffs that scale with how many different classes you control.
desc_group_play_area: Moving cards into or out of play — putting them into play directly, playing them from other zones, or returning them to hand or deck.
desc_group_ready: Readying exhausted cards so they can be used again.
desc_group_recursion: Using cards again — getting them back from the discard pile, playing them from there, or returning them to hand to reuse.
desc_group_remote: Acting at a distance — investigating, moving, or playing events as if you were elsewhere.
desc_group_rfg: Cards that remove themselves from the game for the rest of the scenario.
desc_group_skill_commit: Skill icons for committing — cards that gain icons, and printed icon patterns that make a card a good commit.
desc_group_skill_test_condition: Effects that depend on a skill test succeeding or failing, including on an attack or evasion.
desc_group_skill_value: How much you succeed or fail a skill test by — margin payoffs, shifting the margin, and skill value from resources.
desc_group_slot: Asset slots — extra slots, converting a slot, sharing one, or taking up no slot.
desc_group_stats_mod: Changing your skill values — boosts for one test, lasting or always-on boosts, pumps, substitutions, and set values.
desc_group_tank: Protecting teammates — taking their attacks, encounter cards, or damage and horror onto yourself or your cards.
desc_group_test: Skill tests a card makes you take, repeating a failed test, and effects limited to tests you perform.
desc_group_test_difficulty: Raising or lowering a skill test's difficulty, or caring what it is.
desc_group_testless: Doing without a skill test what normally needs one — dealing damage, evading, discovering clues, moving enemies.
desc_group_timing: When an ability triggers — game and phase steps, skill test steps, and "when" / "after" windows.
desc_group_trait: Cards that support a trait — finding, discounting, powering up, or rewarding Tomes, Spells, Firearms, Allies, and more.
desc_group_uses: Uses — the printed pool of charges, ammo, supplies, or secrets on a card, refilling it, placing tokens elsewhere, or building them up.
desc_tag_action_activate_ignoring_cost: Resolve an asset's action or fast ability (or resolve one again) without paying its cost, often saving the action (e.g. Hand-Eye Coordination).
desc_tag_action_activate_from_hand: Use an asset's ability while the card is still in your hand, without playing it first (e.g. Anchor Chain).
desc_tag_action_additional: Gain extra actions for a turn, for you or another investigator, sometimes usable only for one kind of action (e.g. Leo De Luca).
desc_tag_action_additional_attack: Attack again as part of the same card or ability, without spending another action (e.g. One-Two Punch).
desc_tag_action_bold_fight: An event or ability that performs a fight (bold "Fight."), usually adding its own bonus to the attack (e.g. Machete).
desc_tag_action_bold_engage: An event or ability that performs an engage (bold "Engage."), often reaching an enemy at another location (e.g. Righteous Hunt).
desc_tag_action_bold_evade: An event or ability that performs an evasion attempt (bold "Evade."), often with a different skill or an extra effect (e.g. Blinding Light).
desc_tag_action_bold_investigate: An event or ability that performs an investigation (bold "Investigate."), often with a bonus or an extra reward (e.g. Flashlight).
desc_tag_action_bold_move: An event or ability that performs a move (bold "Move."), often going farther or adding a bonus (e.g. Astral Travel).
desc_tag_action_bold_parley: An event or ability that performs a parley (bold "Parley."), usually dealing with an enemy without fighting it (e.g. Persuasion).
desc_tag_action_bold_resign: Resign through a card (bold "Resign.") from any location, if the scenario has a resign ability in play (e.g. "I'm outta here!").
desc_tag_action_end_turn: End your turn immediately as the price of a powerful effect (e.g. Pay Day).
desc_tag_aoo_no_provoke: An action, card play, or ability that does not provoke attacks of opportunity from engaged enemies (e.g. Cat Burglar).
desc_tag_attach_asset: Attaches to an asset to upgrade it, or attaches assets to itself to hold them (e.g. Trusted).
desc_tag_attach_enemy: Attaches to an enemy, hindering it or rewarding you while it stays attached (e.g. Bind Monster).
desc_tag_attach_location: Attaches to a location, changing what happens there for enemies or investigators (e.g. Barricade).
desc_tag_auto_evade: The card automatically evades an enemy — as its whole effect, or as a bonus after a successful test such as an attack (e.g. Cheap Shot).
desc_tag_auto_success: Makes a skill test automatically succeed, or turns a failed test into a success (e.g. Stroke of Luck).
desc_tag_buff_asset_health: Raises the health of your assets, so they can soak more damage (e.g. Trusted).
desc_tag_buff_asset_sanity: Raises the sanity of your assets, so they can soak more horror (e.g. Trusted).
desc_tag_buff_cannot_attack_you: Enemies cannot attack you for a while, usually until the end of the round (e.g. On the Lam).
desc_tag_cancel_attack: Cancel an enemy attack, including attacks of opportunity (e.g. Dodge).
desc_tag_cancel_chaos: Cancel a revealed chaos token, or the card effect it triggers, often returning it to the bag and revealing a new one (e.g. Counterspell).
desc_tag_cancel_damage: Cancel damage as it is dealt or assigned, so it is never placed (e.g. Armor of Ardennes).
desc_tag_cancel_encounter_draw: Cancel the drawing of an encounter card and draw a different one instead (e.g. Dr. William T. Maleson); cancelling a drawn card's effects is Cancel/Encounter Effect.
desc_tag_cancel_encounter_effect: Cancel all effects of a drawn encounter card, not only a treachery's revelation (e.g. Dark Insight).
desc_tag_cancel_horror: Cancel horror as it is dealt or assigned, so it is never placed (e.g. Devil's Luck).
desc_tag_cancel_revelation: Cancel the revelation effect of a treachery as it is drawn (e.g. Forewarned).
desc_tag_cancel_lose_action: Ignore the "lose actions" part of an encounter card or enemy attack (e.g. Deny Existence).
desc_tag_cancel_lose_resource: Ignore the "lose resources" part of an encounter card or enemy attack (e.g. Deny Existence).
desc_tag_cancel_discard_from_hand: Ignore the "discard cards from hand" part of an encounter card or enemy attack (e.g. Deny Existence).
desc_tag_cancel_failed_test_effects: Cancel all effects of a failed skill test (e.g. Neither Rain nor Snow).
desc_tag_cancel_weakness_draw: Cancel a weakness as it is drawn, or send it back without resolving it (e.g. Ikiaq).
desc_tag_chaos_bag_add_bless: Add bless tokens to the chaos bag (e.g. Keep Faith).
desc_tag_chaos_bag_add_curse: Add curse tokens to the chaos bag, as an effect or as a cost to play or trigger the card (e.g. Promise of Power).
desc_tag_chaos_bag_remove_bless: Remove bless tokens from the chaos bag, often as a cost to pay for a powerful effect (e.g. Hallow).
desc_tag_chaos_bag_remove_curse: Remove curse tokens from the chaos bag, returning them to the token pool (e.g. Harmony Restored).
desc_tag_chaos_bag_replace: Swap tokens in the chaos bag, replacing curse tokens with bless tokens or the other way around (e.g. Tides of Fate).
desc_tag_chaos_downside_damage: Causes damage as a penalty when certain chaos tokens are revealed for this card (e.g. Alchemical Transmutation).
desc_tag_chaos_downside_horror: Causes horror as a penalty when certain chaos tokens are revealed for this card (e.g. Shrivelling).
desc_tag_chaos_downside_resource: Lose resources as a penalty when certain chaos tokens are revealed for this card (e.g. Ineffable Truth).
desc_tag_chaos_do_not_reveal: Skip revealing chaos tokens for a skill test entirely, so the chaos bag can't hurt you (e.g. Will to Survive).
desc_tag_chaos_ignore_effect: Ignore a revealed chaos token's effects, either its symbol effect or the whole token (e.g. Defiance).
desc_tag_chaos_ignore_modifier: Ignore a revealed chaos token's modifier, or treat it as 0 (e.g. Jim Culver).
desc_tag_chaos_modifier: Change a revealed chaos token's modifier, flipping a minus to a plus or setting it to a value like +1 (e.g. Sure Gamble). Setting it to 0 is Chaos/Ignore Modifier.
desc_tag_chaos_resolve_choose: Reveal extra chaos tokens, then choose which ones to resolve and ignore the rest (e.g. Olive McBride).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_before_effect: Acts just before chaos tokens are revealed for a test: add tokens, name a symbol to ignore, or reveal extra or early (e.g. Blessed Blade).
desc_tag_chaos_treat_token_as: Treat a revealed chaos token as a different token, such as turning it into an elder sign (e.g. Eucatastrophe).
desc_tag_chaos_resolve_additional: Resolve a chaos token effect an additional time, or resolve an elder sign effect on top of the tokens revealed (e.g. Eldritch Inspiration).
desc_tag_chaos_predict: Know a chaos token's outcome early: name a token, number, or even/odd before the test, or reveal before committing (e.g. Recall the Future).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_auto_fail: Has an effect keyed to the auto-fail token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Baseball Bat).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_bless: Has an effect keyed to a bless token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Blessed Blade).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_cultist: Has an effect keyed to a cultist token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Second Sight).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_curse: Has an effect keyed to a curse token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Armageddon).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_elder_sign: Has an effect keyed to an elder sign token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. .35 Winchester).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_elder_thing: Has an effect keyed to an elder thing token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Dread Curse of Azathoth).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_skull: Has an effect keyed to a skull token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Song of the Dead).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_token_tablet: Has an effect keyed to a tablet token being revealed, as a bonus or a penalty (e.g. Shadowmeld).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_more: Reveal additional chaos tokens for a skill test, often so you can pick which one to resolve (e.g. Olive McBride).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_manual: Reveal random chaos tokens outside a skill test as a gamble, with the result deciding the effect (e.g. Hypnotic Gaze).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_another_instead: Cancel or ignore a revealed chaos token and reveal a new one in its place, or resolve a specific token instead (e.g. Wendy Adams).
desc_tag_chaos_reveal_sealed_instead: When a chaos token would be revealed, resolve a token sealed on a card instead of drawing from the bag (e.g. Favor of the Sun).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_0: Seal a 0 token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. Shards of the Void).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_any: Search the chaos bag for tokens of your choice and seal them (e.g. Protective Incantation).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_auto_fail: Seal the auto-fail token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. Seal of the Seventh Sign).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_cultist: Can seal a cultist token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. The Chthonian Stone).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_elder_sign: Seal an elder sign token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. The Codex of Ages).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_elder_thing: Can seal an elder thing token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. The Chthonian Stone).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_skull: Can seal a skull token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. The Chthonian Stone).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_tablet: Can seal a tablet token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. The Chthonian Stone).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_bless: Seal bless tokens from the chaos bag, usually to release or spend them later (e.g. Shield of Faith).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_curse: Seal curse tokens, taking them out of the chaos bag until they are released (e.g. Favor of the Moon).
desc_tag_chaos_seal_revealed: Seal a token that was revealed, during a skill test or at random from the bag, rather than one you chose (e.g. Premonition).
desc_tag_clue_additional_this_location: Discover additional clues beyond the normal amount, usually on a successful investigation (e.g. Deduction).
desc_tag_clue_place_your_location: Place clues on your location as an effect, usually your own clues and sometimes from the token bank (e.g. Forewarned).
desc_tag_commit_other_investigator: Commit cards to another investigator's skill test, sometimes even at a different location (e.g. Fighting Lessons).
desc_tag_commit_from_non_hand: Commit cards from somewhere other than your hand: your deck, a discard pile, or cards attached or set beneath (e.g. Persistence).
desc_tag_commit_fetch: Dig a card out of a deck or discard pile and commit it straight to the current skill test (e.g. Practice Makes Perfect).
desc_tag_commit_max: Limits how many can be committed to one skill test, usually "Max 1 committed per skill test" (e.g. Guts).
desc_tag_condition_resource: Only works or scales based on how many resources you have, whether a big pile or none at all (e.g. Dark Horse).
desc_tag_condition_sanity: Only works or scales based on your remaining sanity, most often when it is 3 or lower (e.g. Say Your Prayers).
desc_tag_condition_hand_size: Only works or scales based on how many cards are in your hand (e.g. Higher Education).
desc_tag_cost_action_discard_self: An action ability that costs discarding this card (e.g. Knife).
desc_tag_cost_action_exhaust_self: An action ability that costs exhausting this card, including an optional exhaust written into its effect (e.g. Burglary).
desc_tag_cost_action_multiple: An ability costing two or more actions, or letting you spend extra actions for more effect (e.g. Sledgehammer).
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_resource: An action ability that costs resources, from your pool or from resources such as evidence on the card (e.g. Book of Shadows).
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_secret: An action ability that costs secrets (e.g. In the Know).
desc_tag_cost_discount: Reduces the cost of other cards you or others play (e.g. Ever Vigilant); a card lowering only its own cost is Cost/Discount Self.
desc_tag_cost_free_damage_self: A fast ability that costs taking damage on your investigator (e.g. Sophie).
desc_tag_cost_free_discard_self: A fast ability that costs discarding this card (e.g. Stray Cat).
desc_tag_cost_free_exhaust_self: A fast ability that costs exhausting this card (e.g. Arcane Initiate).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_charge: A fast ability that costs charges (e.g. Bangle of Jinxes).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_resource: A fast ability that costs resources, from your pool or from the card itself (e.g. Physical Training).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_secret: A fast ability that costs secrets (e.g. Eon Chart).
desc_tag_cost_damage_self: Take damage as an additional cost to play or as an optional price in the effect, not as a fast or reaction cost (e.g. Blood Eclipse).
desc_tag_cost_discard_card: Discard other cards, from your hand or an asset you control, as a cost to play the card or use an ability (e.g. Cornered).
desc_tag_cost_add_doom_self: Place doom on a card you control as a cost, trading doom for power (e.g. Blood Pact).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_damage_self: A reaction that costs taking damage on your investigator (e.g. Ritual Dagger).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_discard_self: A reaction that costs discarding this card (e.g. Disc of Itzamna).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_exhaust_self: A reaction that costs exhausting this card, including a conditional exhaust written into its effect (e.g. Rabbit's Foot).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_horror_self: A reaction that costs taking horror on your investigator, not horror placed on the card itself (e.g. Meat Cleaver).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_charge: A reaction that costs charges (e.g. Grotesque Statue).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_resource: A reaction that costs resources, from your pool or from resources such as evidence on the card (e.g. Lucky Dice).
desc_tag_damage_plus: An attack or other damage effect deals extra damage (e.g. .45 Automatic).
desc_tag_damage_instead_range: Instead of standard damage, the attack deals damage equal to how much you succeed by, within a minimum and maximum (e.g. Shotgun).
desc_tag_damage_instead_fail_range: If the attack fails and would hit another investigator, it deals damage equal to how much you failed by, within set limits (e.g. Shotgun).
desc_tag_damage_to_investigator: Deals damage to an investigator, yourself or others, as an effect or penalty (e.g. Dynamite Blast).
desc_tag_damage_redirect_attack: Turns an enemy's attack damage onto another enemy instead of you (e.g. Aquinnah); redirecting your own attack is Damage/Redirect Own Attack.
desc_tag_damage_spread: Divide damage as you choose among several enemies at once (e.g. Flamethrower).
desc_tag_deck_discard_card_choose: Discard a card of your choice from your hand, often after drawing extra cards (e.g. Scroll of Prophecies).
desc_tag_deck_discard_card_random: Discard a random card from your hand (e.g. Liquid Courage).
desc_tag_deck_discard_deck: Discard cards from a player deck, usually from the top (e.g. Short Supply).
desc_tag_deck_discard_encounter: Discard cards from the encounter deck to thin out what's coming (e.g. Scroll of Secrets).
desc_tag_deck_draw_you: Draw cards from your deck (e.g. Rabbit's Foot).
desc_tag_deck_draw_investigator: Lets you choose an investigator, possibly another player, to draw cards (e.g. Cryptic Research).
desc_tag_deck_draw_fill_hand: Draw until your hand reaches a set size, so the number of cards varies (e.g. Nothing Left to Lose).
desc_tag_deck_look_you: Look at or reveal the top cards of your deck (or any player's), maybe reordering them, without searching (e.g. Unbridled Knowledge).
desc_tag_deck_look_encounter: Look at or reveal the top cards of the encounter deck, maybe reordering them (e.g. Scrying).
desc_tag_deck_restriction: Can only go in one specific investigator's deck, or in decks of investigators with certain traits (e.g. Roland's .38 Special).
desc_tag_deck_search_discard: Search a discard pile, yours or another investigator's, for a card (e.g. Smuggled Goods).
desc_tag_deck_search_encounter: Search the encounter deck for a card, usually to pull out an enemy (e.g. On the Hunt).
desc_tag_deck_search_you: Search your deck for a card (e.g. Research Librarian).
desc_tag_deck_search_investigator: Lets you choose an investigator, possibly another player, to search their deck for a card (e.g. No Stone Unturned).
desc_tag_deck_shuffle_encounter: Shuffle cards, often an enemy, into the encounter deck, or shuffle the encounter deck (e.g. Close Call).
desc_tag_deck_shuffle_player: Shuffle cards into a player deck, or shuffle it after a search (e.g. Quantum Flux).
desc_tag_discard_from_play_self: Discards itself from play through its own effect or a Forced condition, not merely as an ability's cost (e.g. Baseball Bat).
desc_tag_discard_from_play_self_no_uses: Discards itself once it runs out of uses or sealed tokens (e.g. First Aid).
desc_tag_discard_pile_to_hand: Return cards from your discard pile to your hand, or play them from there (e.g. Scavenging).
desc_tag_discard_pile_to_deck: Puts cards from a discard pile back into a deck: the whole pile, chosen cards, or a card played from there (e.g. Quantum Flux).
desc_tag_doom_add: Places doom on your own cards, on an enemy or on the agenda, usually for a payoff (e.g. Arcane Initiate).
desc_tag_doom_check: Only works, scales, or triggers when there is doom on your cards or doom is placed on one (e.g. Prophesy, Blood of Thoth).
desc_tag_doom_remove: Removes doom from a card, such as the agenda, an enemy, or your own assets (e.g. Moonlight Ritual).
desc_tag_doom_prevent_advance: Stalls the agenda: it can't advance by doom, some doom doesn't count, or doom can't be placed (e.g. Mystifying Song).
desc_tag_duration_enemy_phase: The effect applies during the enemy phase (e.g. Lure).
desc_tag_duration_next: A one-shot effect that applies to your next skill test, attack, or similar event, then ends (e.g. Fieldwork).
desc_tag_duration_until_end_phase: The effect lasts until the end of the phase (e.g. Encyclopedia).
desc_tag_duration_until_end_round: The effect lasts until the end of the round (e.g. Mind over Matter).
desc_tag_duration_until_end_turn: The effect lasts until the end of the turn (e.g. Will to Survive).
desc_tag_enemy_does_not_ready: Keeps an enemy from readying, so it stays exhausted through the next upkeep phase or while the card is attached (e.g. Slip Away).
desc_tag_enemy_cannot_move_into_location: Non-Elite enemies cannot move into the attached location, walling it off from enemy movement (e.g. Barricade).
desc_tag_enemy_cannot_attack: The attached enemy cannot attack anyone while the card stays on it (e.g. Abyssal Rot).
desc_tag_enemy_cannot_move: The attached enemy cannot move, pinning it where it is (e.g. Virescent Rot); keeping enemies out of a location is Enemy/Cannot Move Into Location.
desc_tag_enemy_exhaust: Exhausts an enemy, so it won't attack or engage until it readies (e.g. Snare Trap).
desc_tag_enemy_mitigation_discard: Discards an enemy outright, removing it from play without defeating it (e.g. Disc of Itzamna).
desc_tag_enemy_mitigation_defeat: Defeats an enemy outright regardless of its remaining health, with no test, a special test, or a successful attack (e.g. Monster Slayer).
desc_tag_enemy_mitigation_back_to_encoun: Shuffles an enemy back into the encounter deck, or places it on the top or bottom, getting rid of it for now (e.g. Close Call).
desc_tag_enemy_value_damage: Uses an enemy's damage value as a number, redirecting its attack's damage or setting a difficulty or reward (e.g. Aquinnah).
desc_tag_enemy_value_evade: Uses an enemy's evade value as a number, such as a test's difficulty or a cost (e.g. Waylay).
desc_tag_enemy_value_evade_reduction: Lowers an enemy's evade value, making it easier to evade (e.g. Stealth).
desc_tag_enemy_value_fight: Uses an enemy's fight value as a number, usually as the difficulty of a test (e.g. Expose Weakness).
desc_tag_enemy_value_fight_reduction: Lowers an enemy's fight value, making it easier to hit (e.g. Improvised Weapon).
desc_tag_enemy_value_horror: Uses an enemy's horror value as a number, such as healing, a test's difficulty or a reward (e.g. Hand of Fate).
desc_tag_exile_self: This card is exiled when used: removed from your deck until you spend experience to buy it again (e.g. A Test of Will).
desc_tag_gain_aloof: Gives an enemy the aloof keyword, so it won't engage you on its own (e.g. Hiding Spot).
desc_tag_gain_retaliate: Gives an enemy the retaliate keyword, so a failed attack against it provokes an attack back (e.g. Knuckleduster).
desc_tag_gain_fast_other: Play another card without spending an action — it gains fast, or you play it through a fast ability or reaction (e.g. Joey "The Rat" Vigil, Fence).
desc_tag_gain_resource_investigator: Another investigator, or whoever performs the test, gains resources: economy support for the team (e.g. Stand Together).
desc_tag_gain_resource_move_investigator: Moves or trades resources between investigators rather than gaining new ones (e.g. Teamwork).
desc_tag_hand_size_max_increase: Increases your maximum hand size, so you discard less at the end of the upkeep phase (e.g. Laboratory Assistant).
desc_tag_hand_size_dependent: Scales with, or only works at, a number of cards in your hand; some reward a big hand, others punish it (e.g. Higher Education).
desc_tag_heal_damage_you: Heals damage from your own investigator (e.g. Second Wind).
desc_tag_heal_damage_investigator: Heals damage from an investigator you choose, including other players (e.g. Emergency Aid).
desc_tag_heal_damage_ally: Heals damage from an Ally or other asset, keeping it in play longer (e.g. Inspiring Presence).
desc_tag_heal_damage_self: This card heals damage from itself, restoring its own soak over time (e.g. Jessica Hyde).
desc_tag_heal_horror_you: Heals horror from your own investigator (e.g. Moment of Respite).
desc_tag_heal_horror_investigator: Heals horror from an investigator you choose, including other players (e.g. Liquid Courage).
desc_tag_heal_horror_ally: Heals horror from an Ally or other asset, keeping it in play longer (e.g. Inspiring Presence).
desc_tag_heal_horror_self: This card heals horror from itself, restoring its own soak over time (e.g. Peter Sylvestre).
desc_tag_location_clue_exist: Only works, or gets stronger, while there is at least 1 clue on your location (e.g. Preposterous Sketches).
desc_tag_location_clue_zero: Only works when your location has no clues, or triggers when its last clue is discovered (e.g. Connect the Dots).
desc_tag_location_enemy_zero: Only works when there are no enemies at your location, or moves you to a location with none (e.g. Moment of Respite).
desc_tag_multiclass_class_count: Scales with the number of different classes among cards you control: the more classes, the bigger the payoff (e.g. Gang Up).
desc_tag_play_area_to_hand: Returns a card from play to your hand, often to replay it or save it from the discard pile (e.g. Magnifying Glass).
desc_tag_play_area_to_deck: Sends a card back into your deck instead of the discard pile, shuffled in or placed on the bottom (e.g. Improvised Shield).
desc_tag_play_area_into_play_from_hand: Puts a card from your hand directly into play, skipping the normal play action or cost (e.g. Sleight of Hand).
desc_tag_play_area_into_play_from_deck: Puts a card directly into play from a deck, skipping your hand (e.g. Dr. Elli Horowitz).
desc_tag_play_area_into_play_from_discar: Puts a card directly into play from a discard pile (e.g. A Chance Encounter).
desc_tag_play_area_play_from_other_zone: Plays a card, paying its cost, from outside your hand, such as a discard pile, your deck or another player's hand (e.g. Wendy's Amulet).
desc_tag_ready_self: Readies itself after being exhausted, so you can use its exhaust ability again (e.g. Mauser C96).
desc_tag_ready_asset: Readies another asset, sometimes only one of a certain trait or class, so its exhaust ability can be used again (e.g. Galvanize).
desc_tag_recursion_asset: Gets an asset back from the discard pile, into your hand or straight into play (e.g. A Chance Encounter).
desc_tag_recursion_event: Gets an event back after it has been played, usually returning it from your discard pile to your hand (e.g. The Book of War).
desc_tag_recursion_skill: Returns a committed skill card to your hand, or lets you commit a skill again from your discard pile (e.g. Try and Try Again).
desc_tag_recursion_play_from_discard: Play a card directly from your discard pile, without returning it to your hand first (e.g. Improvised Weapon).
desc_tag_recursion_self_to_hand: Returns itself to your hand instead of being discarded, often when you succeed by enough, so you can use it again (e.g. Opportunist).
desc_tag_recursion_replay: Play an event a second time, or keep replaying it without it going to your discard pile (e.g. Double, Double).
desc_tag_remote_investigate: Investigate a location other than your own, as if you were there (e.g. In the Know).
desc_tag_remote_move: Move to a location that doesn't have to connect to yours, such as any revealed location (e.g. Elusive).
desc_tag_rfg_self: Removes itself from the game after use or as a cost: gone for this scenario, but unlike exile it needs no XP to return (e.g. The Gold Pocket Watch).
desc_tag_skill_commit_gain_icon: A committed card gains extra skill icons, often wild icons or a number that scales with a count (e.g. Leadership).
desc_tag_skill_test_condition_successful: Has an effect that happens only if the skill test succeeds (e.g. Fearless); success effects on an attack or evasion are Successful During an Attack / Evade.
desc_tag_skill_test_condition_fail: Has an effect that happens only if the skill test fails, either a consolation or a penalty (e.g. Take Heart).
desc_tag_skill_test_condition_successful: Has an effect that happens only if an attack succeeds, such as extra damage (e.g. Vicious Blow).
desc_tag_skill_value_succeed_by_dynamic: The effect grows with how much you succeed by, "for each point you succeed by" (e.g. Shotgun).
desc_tag_skill_value_succeed_by_or_more: Gives a bonus only if you succeed by a set amount or more, such as 2 or more (e.g. Switchblade).
desc_tag_skill_value_fail_by_or_less: Rewards a near miss: triggers when you fail a skill test by a set amount or less (e.g. "Look what I found!").
desc_tag_skill_value_fail_by_dynamic: A benefit that grows with how much you fail a skill test by (e.g. Rabbit's Foot, level 3).
desc_tag_skill_value_succeed_by_exactly: Pays off only when you succeed by an exact amount (e.g. Katana).
desc_tag_skill_value_fail_by_exactly: Pays off only when you fail by an exact amount (e.g. Crystal Pendulum).
desc_tag_skill_value_from_resource: Adds to or sets your skill value based on how many resources you have, without spending them (e.g. Well Connected).
desc_tag_slot_additional_accessory: Gives you an extra accessory slot, sometimes only for certain traits (e.g. Relic Hunter).
desc_tag_slot_additional_ally: Gives you an extra ally slot, sometimes only for certain allies (e.g. Charisma).
desc_tag_slot_additional_arcane: Gives you an extra arcane slot, sometimes only for certain traits such as Spell (e.g. Book of Shadows).
desc_tag_slot_additional_hand: Gives you an extra hand slot, sometimes only for certain traits such as Weapon or Tome (e.g. Bandolier).
desc_tag_slot_additional_tarot: Gives you an extra tarot slot (e.g. Anna Kaslow).
desc_tag_slot_convert: Lets slots of one type hold cards that normally take up another type (e.g. The Hierophant • V).
desc_tag_stats_mod_add_stat: Adds the value of a second skill on top of the skill being tested (e.g. Lockpicks).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_in_test_combat: Gives you a combat bonus for a single skill test, such as one attack (e.g. Machete).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_in_test_agility: Gives you an agility bonus for a single skill test, such as one evasion attempt (e.g. Hard Knocks).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_in_test_intelle: Gives you an intellect bonus for a single skill test, such as one investigation (e.g. Hyperawareness).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_in_test_willpow: Gives you a willpower bonus for a single skill test (e.g. Arcane Studies).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_in_test_any: Adds to your skill value for a single skill test, whatever skill is being tested (e.g. Lucky!).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_passive_combat: An always-on combat bonus while the card is in play, sometimes only under a condition (e.g. Beat Cop).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_passive_agility: An always-on agility bonus while the card is in play, sometimes only under a condition (e.g. Cat Burglar).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_passive_intelle: An always-on intellect bonus while in play, sometimes only under a condition such as while investigating (e.g. Magnifying Glass).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_passive_willpow: An always-on willpower bonus while the card is in play, sometimes only under a condition (e.g. Holy Rosary).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_passive_any: An always-on bonus to each of your skills or to your skill value, sometimes only in certain tests or conditions (e.g. Key of Ys).
desc_tag_stats_mod_pump_resource: Spend resources as many times as you like for a bigger skill bonus: the more you pay, the more you get (e.g. Physical Training).
desc_tag_stats_mod_set_base: Sets a skill's base value to a fixed number instead of adding a bonus (e.g. Duke).
desc_tag_stats_mod_use_instead: Lets a test use one skill in place of another, such as agility instead of combat (e.g. Backstab).
desc_tag_tank_redirect_attack: An enemy attacking another investigator resolves its attack against you instead (e.g. Heroic Rescue).
desc_tag_tank_redirect_encounter: Draw or resolve an encounter card in place of another investigator (e.g. "Let me handle this!").
desc_tag_tank_redirect_damage_horror: Lets you or your cards take damage or horror dealt to other investigators (e.g. True Grit); taking the whole enemy attack instead is Tank/Redirect Attack.
desc_tag_test_initiate_agility: Has you or another investigator test agility against a difficulty set by the card, outside a normal evasion attempt (e.g. Waylay).
desc_tag_test_initiate_combat: Has you or another investigator test combat against a difficulty set by the card, outside a normal attack (e.g. Interrogate).
desc_tag_test_initiate_intellect: Has you or another investigator test intellect against a difficulty set by the card, outside a normal investigation (e.g. Medical Texts).
desc_tag_test_initiate_willpower: Has you or another investigator test willpower against a difficulty set by the card (e.g. Liquid Courage).
desc_tag_test_you_perform: Only works on skill tests you perform yourself, not on other investigators' tests (e.g. Opportunist).
desc_tag_test_repeat_failed: Lets you attempt a failed skill test again (e.g. Live and Learn).
desc_tag_test_difficulty_reduce: Lowers a skill test's difficulty directly, rather than boosting your skill or reducing a location's shroud (e.g. Fine Clothes).
desc_tag_testless_damage_your_location: Deal damage to an enemy at your location without a test (e.g. Beat Cop).
desc_tag_testless_damage_your_location_m: Deal damage to several or all enemies at a location at once, with no test against each one (e.g. Dynamite Blast).
desc_tag_testless_damage_connecting_loca: Deal damage without a test to an enemy at a connecting location or farther away (e.g. Dynamite Blast).
desc_tag_testless_damage_attacking_enemy: Deal damage without a test to an enemy that attacks (e.g. Guard Dog).
desc_tag_testless_clue: Discover clues without investigating or taking a test (e.g. Working a Hunch).
desc_tag_testless_evade: Evades an enemy you never test against — no evasion attempt against that enemy at all (e.g. Stray Cat, or the extra enemies Survival Instinct evades).
desc_tag_timing_after_enemy_attacks: Triggers after an enemy attacks you or an investigator at your location, even if the attack was canceled (e.g. Daniela Reyes).
desc_tag_timing_after_enters_play: Triggers after the card itself enters play, for a one-time effect on arrival such as a search or draw (e.g. Research Librarian).
desc_tag_timing_after_successfully_inves: Triggers each time you successfully investigate (e.g. Dr. Milan Christopher); a card's own "Investigate. If you succeed…" bonus doesn't count.
desc_tag_timing_after_fail_skill_test: Triggers after you fail a skill test, turning the failure into a benefit (e.g. Rabbit's Foot); a card's own "if you fail" clause doesn't count.
desc_tag_timing_after_engage_enemy: Triggers when or after you become engaged with an enemy (e.g. Zoey's Cross).
desc_tag_timing_during_your_turn: Can only be played or used during your turn, or triggers on something you do during your turn (e.g. Working a Hunch).
desc_tag_timing_game_draw_opening_hands: Triggers before, when or after you draw your opening hand, such as setting cards aside or changing its size (e.g. Stick to the Plan).
desc_tag_timing_game_begins: Takes effect as the game begins: start with a card in play or extra resources, or put a card from your opening hand into play (e.g. Ace of Swords).
desc_tag_timing_game_ends: Triggers when the game ends (or when you resign or are eliminated), often costing or rewarding you based on the card's state (e.g. Green Man Medallion).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st1_determine_skil: Triggers as a skill test begins, before cards are committed, such as changing which skill is tested (e.g. Money Talks).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st2_commit_cards: Triggers when or after cards are committed to a skill test (e.g. Grisly Totem).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st3_reveal_chaos_t: Triggers around revealing chaos tokens in a skill test, including "if a skull, cultist, tablet or elder thing is revealed" riders (e.g. Shrivelling).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st4_apply_chaos_ef: Triggers as revealed chaos tokens' effects resolve, such as ignoring or reacting to their symbols (e.g. Defiance).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st5_determine_skil: Triggers at the skill test step where your modified skill value is totaled, after chaos token modifiers apply.
desc_tag_timing_skill_st6_determine_resu: Triggers when a skill test would succeed or fail, while the result can still change (e.g. Lucky!).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st7_apply_results: Triggers after you succeed at or fail a skill test, as its results are applied (e.g. Lucky Cigarette Case).
desc_tag_timing_skill_st8_test_ends: Triggers when or after a skill test ends, once all its results have resolved (e.g. Live and Learn).
desc_tag_timing_when_enemy_attacks: Triggers when an enemy attacks you or an investigator at your location, before the attack resolves, such as to cancel it (e.g. Dodge).
desc_tag_timing_when_defeat_enemy: Triggers after you (or someone at your location) defeat an enemy (e.g. Roland Banks); a weapon's own "if this attack defeats" bonus doesn't count.
desc_tag_timing_when_enemy_spawns_your_l: Triggers when an enemy spawns at your location (e.g. Disc of Itzamna).
desc_tag_trait_support_tome: Finds, plays or rewards Tome assets, such as searching for one or a bonus while you control one (e.g. Research Librarian).
desc_tag_trait_support_firearm: Supports Firearm assets with extra ammo, attack bonuses, searches or discounts (e.g. Extra Ammunition).
desc_tag_trait_support_melee: Rewards attacking with Melee assets, or helps pay for them (e.g. Flurry of Blows).
desc_tag_trait_support_ranged: Boosts attacks made with Ranged assets (e.g. Marksmanship).
desc_tag_trait_support_spell: Finds, discounts, recharges or rewards playing Spell cards (e.g. Book of Shadows).
desc_tag_trait_support_insight: Finds, replays or rewards Insight events (e.g. Eidetic Memory).
desc_tag_trait_support_tactic: Finds, discounts or speeds up Tactic events (e.g. Chuck Fergus).
desc_tag_trait_support_relic: Finds, recharges or rewards controlling Relic assets (e.g. Dr. Elli Horowitz).
desc_tag_trait_support_spirit: Finds or pays for Spirit cards (e.g. Boxing Gloves).
desc_tag_trait_support_practiced: Finds and commits Practiced skills (e.g. Practice Makes Perfect).
desc_tag_trait_support_innate: Recovers or otherwise supports Innate skills (e.g. True Survivor).
desc_tag_trait_support_illicit: Finds, speeds up or stores Illicit cards (e.g. Fence).
desc_tag_trait_support_supply: Finds or stores Supply cards (e.g. Backpack).
desc_tag_trait_support_weapon: Finds, plays or upgrades Weapon assets (e.g. Prepared for the Worst).
desc_tag_trait_support_science: Powers up or rewards controlling Science assets (e.g. Fine Tuning).
desc_tag_trait_support_ally: Retrieves, plays, trades or protects Ally assets (e.g. A Chance Encounter).
desc_tag_trait_support_trick: Finds, discounts or speeds up Trick cards (e.g. Chuck Fergus).
desc_tag_trait_support_item: Retrieves, discounts, plays or trades Item assets (e.g. Scavenging).
desc_tag_uses_accumulate: Starts empty and builds up tokens on itself as you play (evidence, offerings and the like), then spends them for a payoff (e.g. Decorated Skull).
desc_tag_uses_replenish: Refills its own uses up to a limit, each round or when a condition is met (e.g. Physical Training).
desc_tag_uses_starting_ammo: Has a printed ammo pool, "Uses (X ammo)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. .45 Automatic).
desc_tag_uses_starting_charge: Has a printed charge pool, "Uses (X charges)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. Shrivelling).
desc_tag_uses_starting_supply: Has a printed supply pool, "Uses (X supplies)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. Flashlight).
desc_tag_uses_starting_secret: Has a printed secret pool, "Uses (X secrets)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. Old Book of Lore).
desc_tag_uses_starting_evidence: Has a printed evidence pool, "Uses (X evidence)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. Damning Testimony).
desc_tag_uses_starting_offering: Has a printed offering pool, "Uses (X offerings)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. Wolf Mask).
desc_tag_uses_starting_resource: Has a printed pool of resources on the card, "Uses (X resources)", kept separate from your resource pool (e.g. Physical Training).
desc_tag_uses_starting_inspiration: Has a printed inspiration pool, "Uses (X inspiration)", spent to fuel its abilities (e.g. Book of Verse).
desc_tag_uses_support_ammo: Gives your Firearms more ammo — adds it to them, or holds ammo they can spend as if it were their own (e.g. Extra Ammunition, Cleaning Kit).
desc_tag_uses_support_charge: Gives your assets more charges — adds or moves charges onto them, or holds charges they can spend as if they were their own (e.g. Book of Shadows, Lost Arcana).
desc_tag_uses_support_supply: Gives your assets more supplies — adds them, or holds supplies they can spend as if they were their own (e.g. Emergency Cache, Cleaning Kit).
desc_tag_uses_support_secret: Gives your assets more secrets — adds or moves secrets onto them, or holds secrets they can spend as if they were their own (e.g. Truth from Fiction, Typewriter).
desc_tag_uses_support_evidence: Adds evidence to an asset you control (e.g. Darrell Simmons).
desc_compound_thorns: Hurts an enemy back for attacking — testless damage to the attacker, or an attack aimed at it (Guard Dog, Counterpunch).
desc_compound_discard_self: Discards itself as the cost of a triggered ability (Beat Cop, Knife, Stray Cat) — the discard-for-value archetype.
desc_compound_support: Helps OTHER investigators, not just yourself — a non-selfish, team-oriented effect (healing others, sharing draws/searches, buffing allies).
desc_compound_clue_tech: Clue-finding technology: discover clues bypassing or easing the investigate test — discover-without-investigating, shroud reduction, or testless clues. (Extra clues on a SUCCESSFUL investigation is not clue-tech — see Investigate.)
desc_compound_spend_resource: Spends resources as a cost — a payoff for a 'big money' economy.
desc_compound_attack_mitigation: Stops an enemy attack from landing on you — cancels, "cannot attack you", redirecting the damage to another enemy.
desc_compound_succeed_by: Cares about how much you succeed a test by — margin payoffs, and cards that shift the margin.
desc_compound_fail_by: Cares about how much you fail a test by — margin payoffs, and cards that shift the margin.
desc_compound_investigate: Payoffs that fire after a successful investigation or a clue discovery.
desc_compound_into_play_cheat: Puts a card into play bypassing the play action, or plays it at no cost.
desc_compound_bold_action: Bundles a basic action (Fight / Evade / Investigate / Parley / Resign) into the card's own ability, whichever action it is.
desc_compound_chaos_token_control: Plays with the chaos-bag draw: reveal more, ignore, cancel, predict, change a modifier, treat tokens as something else, or seal bad tokens away.
desc_compound_bless_curse_bag: Adds, removes, replaces, seals, or counts Bless / Curse tokens in the chaos bag, or pays off revealing them.
desc_compound_big_money: Cares about HAVING a large resource pool — converting resources into power or scaling with how many you hold. (Merely generating resources is Economy.)
desc_compound_evasion_package: The EVADE mechanic — auto/testless evade, mass evade, making evade easier, and disengaging. Rewards for having evaded are Evade Payoff.
desc_compound_protector_tank: Take hits for the team — redirect attacks, encounter cards, or damage/horror onto yourself, or move a teammate’s damage onto your cards.
desc_compound_fail_forward: Turns failure into upside, or softens it — payoffs for failing, retries, or canceling a failed test's effects.
desc_compound_discard_pile_value: Gets value back out of the discard pile — play, commit, or put cards into play from it, or return them to hand or deck.
desc_compound_action_compression: Do MORE PER ACTION — cheaper/free activations, an extra attack inside one action, or readying to act again. (Simply gaining extra actions is Extra Actions, not compression.)
desc_compound_health_safety: Protects your HEALTH — extra health (soak, +health), cancelling damage, healing it, or moving it off you onto an enemy.
desc_compound_sanity_safety: Protects your SANITY — extra sanity (soak, +sanity), cancelling horror, and horror healing (e.g. Peter Sylvestre).
desc_compound_tome_support: Cards that care about the Tome trait — Tome support and Tome-only slots.
desc_compound_spell_support: Cards that care about the Spell trait — Spell support and Spell-only arcane slots.
desc_compound_relic_support: Cards that care about the Relic trait.
desc_compound_weapon_support: Supports Weapons and their Firearm / Melee / Ranged sub-traits, including hand slots restricted to them.
desc_compound_ally_support: Cares about Ally assets — ally slots, readying allies, buffing their health and sanity.
desc_tag_condition_engaged_alone: Only works when the enemy is the only one engaged with you (e.g. Machete).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_combat: Gives a combat bonus that lasts beyond one test, such as until the end of the phase or round (e.g. Keen Eye).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_agility: Gives an agility bonus that lasts beyond one test, such as until the end of the round (e.g. Fight or Flight).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_intelle: Gives an intellect bonus that lasts beyond one test, such as until the end of the phase (e.g. Keen Eye).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_willpow: Gives a willpower bonus that lasts beyond one test, such as until the end of the phase or round.
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_any: Gives a bonus to any skill that outlasts the current test, such as for your next test or until the end of the phase (e.g. Encyclopedia).
desc_compound_passive_boost: An always-on (or condition-gated) skill boost while the card is in play — no per-test commitment needed.
desc_compound_cancel: Negates an incoming thing outright — an attack, damage, horror, a draw, a test result, a weakness, or another effect (a Diana Stanley payoff).
desc_compound_enemy_mitigation: Neutralizes an enemy outright — discard it, defeat it regardless of health, shuffle it back, push it away, or stop it attacking or engaging.
desc_compound_area_damage: Hits MULTIPLE enemies at once — every enemy at a location, or damage spread among them.
desc_compound_efficient_damage: Deals more damage per attack — +damage riders, extra attacks, damage that scales with how much you succeed by, or carrying an attack’s damage to another enemy.
desc_compound_search: Digs through a deck (yours, another investigator’s, the discard, or the encounter deck) for a specific card, or pays off being found by a search.
desc_compound_economy: Resources and discounts — gaining or moving resources, cheaper plays, paying from a card’s stored resources, plays at no cost.
desc_compound_clue_on_location: Cares about whether clues are ON a location — keyed to clue presence/absence, or dropping clues to set that up.
desc_compound_off_stat_combat: Fight with a stat other than combat, or evade with one other than agility — use it instead, or add it on top (Mind over Matter, Spectral Razor).
desc_compound_extra_actions: Grants additional actions for the turn — MORE actions, not more per action (distinct from action compression).
desc_group_soak: Assets with enough health or sanity to take damage or horror for you.
desc_tag_soak_health: An asset (usually an ally) with 2 or more health, so it can take damage for you and survive to be healed (e.g. Guard Dog).
desc_tag_soak_sanity: An asset (usually an ally) with 2 or more sanity, so it can take horror for you and survive to be healed (e.g. Dr. Milan Christopher).
desc_group_victory: The victory display — adding this card or an encounter card to it.
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_charge: An action ability that costs charges, usually a spell (e.g. Shrivelling); a firearm spending ammo is Cost/Action Spend Ammo.
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_supply: An action ability that costs supplies (e.g. First Aid).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_supply: A fast ability that costs supplies (e.g. Canteen).
desc_tag_cost_free_horror_self: A fast ability that costs taking horror on your investigator (e.g. Painkillers).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_clue: A reaction that costs one of your clues, placed on your location (e.g. Dr. William T. Maleson).
desc_tag_deck_look_investigator: Look at or reveal the top cards of another investigator's deck, maybe reordering them (e.g. Parallel Fates).
desc_tag_enemy_trait_restriction: Only works on enemies with a specific printed trait, such as Monster or Humanoid (e.g. Handcuffs).
desc_tag_enemy_target_exhausted: Only works on, or gets a bonus against, an exhausted enemy, so it pairs well with evading first (e.g. Sneak Attack).
tag_skill_test_condition_successful_duri: Skill Test Condition/Successful During an Evade
desc_tag_skill_test_condition_successful: Has an effect that happens only if an evasion attempt succeeds (e.g. Blinding Light).
desc_tag_timing_after_evade_enemy: Triggers after you evade an enemy, or after an enemy at your location is evaded (e.g. Pickpocketing).
desc_tag_timing_after_play_card_of_trait: Triggers when or after you play a card of a certain trait or type, such as a Spell or any event (e.g. Heirloom of Hyperborea).
desc_tag_timing_when_would_fail_test: Triggers when a skill test would fail, so a last-second boost can still flip it (e.g. Lucky!); once it has failed is Timing/After Fail Skill Test.
desc_tag_victory_display_self: Adds itself to the victory display, often scoring victory points or extra experience (e.g. Delve Too Deep).
desc_compound_multi_enemy: Deals with MULTIPLE enemies at once — area damage, mass evade, mass disengage, or mass engage (Dynamite Blast, Elusive, Cat Burglar).
desc_compound_combat_boost: Makes you better at FIGHTING — any combat boost, whether for one test, passive, or lasting.
desc_compound_agility_boost: Makes you better at EVADING — any agility boost, whether for one test, passive, or lasting.
desc_compound_intellect_boost: Makes you better at INVESTIGATING — any intellect boost, whether for one test, passive, or lasting.
desc_compound_draw: Refills your hand — draw cards for yourself or another investigator (the Harvey Walters engine).
desc_compound_big_hand: Cares about how many cards are in your hand — scaling with, or raising, your hand size (Harvey Walters).
desc_compound_commit: The committing-skill-cards archetype — commit to others, from outside your hand, fetch skills, add icons, or care how many cards are committed (Winifred Habbamock).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_secret: A reaction that costs secrets (e.g. Scrying Mirror).
desc_tag_deck_draw_encounter: Voluntarily draw cards from the encounter deck, usually for a payoff (e.g. Drawn to the Flame).
desc_tag_enemy_ignore_keyword: Ignores or removes a specific enemy keyword such as aloof, retaliate, alert or elusive, without blanking the enemy (e.g. .45 Automatic).
desc_tag_testless_damage_evaded_enemy: Deal damage without a test to the enemy you just evaded (e.g. Blinding Light).
desc_compound_treachery_handling: Answers treacheries / encounter effects — cancel a revelation or effect, discard or blank a treachery, skip drawing encounter cards, or hand yours to another investigator.
desc_compound_encounter_deck: Draws, looks at, searches, or discards from the encounter deck.
desc_compound_chaos_token_downside: Suffers when a bad chaos symbol is revealed — the risk side of spell weapons (Shrivelling, Blinding Light).
desc_compound_doom_adding: Puts doom into play for power — on cards you control (the Marie / Amina archetype), on an enemy or on the agenda — or pays doom as a cost.
desc_compound_self_harm_damage: Pay with your own HEALTH to activate an ability.
desc_compound_self_harm_horror: Pay with your own SANITY to activate an ability.
desc_compound_heal_damage: Removes DAMAGE — from you, another investigator, an ally/asset, or this card (Vincent Lee).
desc_compound_heal_horror: Removes HORROR — from you, another investigator, an ally/asset, or this card — or pays off healing it (Carolyn Fern).
desc_compound_conditional_passive_boost: An always-on boost that only applies to one kind of action (Magnifying Glass: +1 intellect only while investigating).
desc_compound_exhausts: An ability that exhausts the card as its cost (action / reaction / free) — the broad exhaust-engine surface.
desc_compound_player_deck_look: Look at / reorder the top of a player deck — yours or an ally’s.
desc_compound_keyword_suppression: Turns off an enemy’s abilities — blank its text, or ignore one keyword like Retaliate / Aloof / Elusive.
desc_tag_condition_clue_held: Only works or scales based on how many clues you control (e.g. Newspaper).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_clue: A fast ability that costs one of your clues, placed on your location (e.g. Quick Study).
desc_tag_testless_damage_engaged_enemy: Deal damage without a test to one enemy engaged with you, often one that just engaged you (e.g. Zoey's Cross).
desc_tag_chaos_downside_action: Lose actions (one, or all you have left) as a penalty when certain chaos tokens are revealed for this card (e.g. Blinding Light).
desc_tag_cost_horror_self: Take horror as an additional cost or built-in price of the card's effect, not as a fast or reaction cost (e.g. Ward of Protection).
desc_compound_evade_payoff: Rewarded for evading in general — a passive evade boost, or a trigger after you evade (Pickpocketing). Cards that do the evading are Evasion Package.
desc_compound_additional_slot: Grants an extra play slot (arcane, hand, ally, accessory, tarot) so you can field more assets (Book of Shadows, Charisma).
desc_compound_enemy_nerf: Puts a lingering negative on an enemy — it cannot attack, move, ready, or engage you on its own, is exhausted, or has its text blanked (Mind Wipe, Hiding Spot).
desc_compound_efficient_clue: More clues per investigation — additional clues at the location or elsewhere, on top of the normal one (Rite of Seeking, Deciphered Reality).
desc_tag_chaos_downside_discard: Discard something when certain chaos tokens are revealed for this card: the card itself, a card in hand, or an asset (e.g. Baseball Bat).
desc_compound_action_uses_cost: An action ability paid for by spending a printed use token — the "Uses (N): spend 1" weapon, tool, and spell engine.
desc_compound_off_stat_investigation: Investigate with a stat other than intellect — use another stat instead (Rite of Seeking) or add one on top (Lockpicks).
desc_compound_remote_clue: Gathers clues from a location other than your own — investigate or discover at a connecting, revealed, or any location (Seeking Answers, In the Know).
desc_tag_commit_benefits_performer: Its benefit goes to the investigator performing the test, so it fully helps whoever you commit it to (e.g. Take Heart).
desc_compound_mobility: Moves you or the performing investigator — repositioning or moving as part of another action (Duke, Pathfinder).
desc_compound_engagement: Revolves around enemy engagement — pulling enemies to you, triggering off engaging, or caring about being engaged with exactly one (Taunt, Machete).
desc_compound_cross_deck: Uses a card or resources belonging to another investigator — play a teammate’s card, or move resources between investigators.
desc_tag_play_area_from_investigator: Plays or puts into play a card from another investigator's deck, discard pile or hand (e.g. A Chance Encounter).
desc_tag_attach_investigator: Attaches to an investigator, so it goes wherever they go instead of staying at a location (e.g. Delay the Inevitable).
desc_tag_buff_investigator_health: Raises your investigator's maximum health (e.g. Five of Pentacles).
desc_tag_buff_investigator_sanity: Raises your investigator's maximum sanity (e.g. Five of Pentacles).
desc_tag_enemy_value_health_reduction: Lowers an enemy's health, so less damage is needed to defeat it (e.g. Wither, level 4).
desc_tag_timing_after_heal_horror: Triggers after you heal horror, rewarding the healing rather than doing it (e.g. Carolyn Fern).
desc_tag_timing_after_discover_clue: Triggers after you discover clues by any means, with or without a test, or after the last clue at your location is discovered (e.g. Alice Luxley).
desc_tag_uses_starting_try: Has a printed pool of tries, "Uses (X tries)", spent to fuel its ability (e.g. Try and Try Again).
desc_tag_uses_starting_key: Has a printed key pool, "Uses (X keys)", used up as you investigate with it (e.g. Old Keyring).
desc_tag_uses_starting_lock: Has a printed lock pool, "Uses (X locks)" per investigator, removed to unlock its payoff (e.g. The Council's Coffer).
desc_compound_difficulty_reduction: Every way to lower the effective difficulty (target number) of a test — a direct difficulty cut or a location's shroud reduction. The target-lowering counterpart to boosting your own skill value.
desc_tag_enemy_nonweakness: Only works on non-weakness enemies; a weakness enemy cannot be chosen (e.g. Close Call).
desc_tag_buff_cannot_engage_you: Enemies cannot engage you for a while, letting you move past them freely (e.g. Stealth).
desc_tag_discard_treachery_in_play: Discard a treachery that is already in play, such as one in a threat area; removal, not a cancel (e.g. Alter Fate).
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_ammo: An action ability that costs ammo, usually a firearm's attack (e.g. .45 Automatic).
desc_tag_deck_look_place_bottom: Put a looked-at card on the bottom of its deck instead of back on top (e.g. Alyssa Graham).
desc_tag_uses_self_place: Places a use token back on itself, often refunding one after a failed attack (e.g. .18 Derringer).
desc_group_campaign: Benefits between scenarios — improving your deck for less experience.
desc_group_control: Who controls a card — targeting your own cards, or giving an asset to another investigator.
desc_tag_chaos_symbol_payoff: Gain a bonus when a specific chaos token is revealed, such as extra damage, a clue, readying, or returning to hand (e.g. Song of the Dead).
desc_tag_control_your_card: The effect targets a card you control, such as one of your assets, rather than something chosen by location (e.g. Moonlight Ritual).
desc_tag_phase_skip: Skips a phase or a step of one, such as drawing encounter cards in the mythos phase (e.g. The Gold Pocket Watch).
desc_tag_phase_repeat: Repeats an entire phase, such as taking a whole extra investigation phase (e.g. Ultimate Sacrifice).
desc_tag_timing_when_take_damage: Triggers when damage is dealt to or placed on you or one of your cards; some count only damage from an enemy attack (e.g. Guard Dog).
desc_tag_timing_when_take_horror: Triggers when horror is dealt to or placed on you or one of your cards (e.g. Agnes Baker); some count only horror from an enemy attack.
desc_group_defeat: Cards that defeat your own investigator on purpose.
desc_group_limit: Printed limits on how many of a kind of card can be in play.
desc_tag_action_lose: Lose one or more actions, usually as a drawback or when a bad chaos token is revealed (e.g. Blinding Light).
desc_tag_campaign_deck_swap_between_game: Improves your deck between scenarios: swap cards, pay less experience to upgrade or buy cards, or mark upgrade checkboxes (e.g. Adaptable).
desc_tag_clue_discover_any_location: Discover clues at a location that can be anywhere, not just yours or a connecting one (e.g. Connect the Dots).
desc_tag_clue_discover_connecting_locati: Discover clues at a connecting location, or split them among your location and connecting ones (e.g. Snitch).
desc_tag_clue_discover_your_location: Discover clues at your location directly, not as the result of a successful investigation (e.g. Working a Hunch).
desc_tag_defeat_self: Defeats your own investigator on purpose as part of its effect (e.g. Ghastly Revelation).
desc_tag_enemy_elite_noneliteonly: Only works against non-Elite enemies; an Elite enemy is unaffected (e.g. Disc of Itzamna). A weaker version against Elites is Elite Reduced Effect.
desc_tag_enemy_elite_reducedeffect: Still works on an Elite enemy, but gives a weaker result against it than against a non-Elite (e.g. Spectral Razor).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_effect: Causes one or more enemies to become engaged through a card effect rather than the basic engage action (e.g. Taunt).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_none: Only works while you are not engaged with any enemies (e.g. Pathfinder).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_not_with_you: The effect targets, or gets a bonus against, an enemy that is not engaged with you (e.g. Springfield M1903).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_with_another: The effect targets, or changes when used against, an enemy engaged with another investigator (e.g. Blackjack).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_with_you: Forces an enemy to engage you, pulling it off a teammate or onto you to tank it (e.g. Heroic Rescue). Effects on enemies already engaged with you are Engage Target Engaged.
desc_tag_enemy_engage_target_engaged: The effect targets, or scales with, enemies already engaged with you (e.g. Mano a Mano).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_disengage: Disengages you from enemies, or an enemy from everyone, usually as part of an escape; some versions leave the enemy ready (e.g. Elusive).
desc_tag_enemy_evade_multiple: Evades several or all enemies at once, such as each enemy engaged with you or at your location (e.g. Cunning Distraction).
desc_tag_enemy_engage_with_you_multiple: Engages several or all enemies at your location with you at once, pulling the whole fight onto you (e.g. Taunt).
desc_tag_limit_in_play: A printed cap on how many cards with a trait can be in play, per investigator or per location (e.g. Moxie: Limit 1 Composure in play).
desc_tag_location_connecting_enemy: The effect targets an enemy at a connecting location, such as attacking, evading or pulling it from afar (e.g. Marksmanship).
desc_tag_location_connecting_investigato: The effect targets an investigator at a connecting location, reaching beyond your own location (e.g. Guardian Angel).
desc_tag_location_move_clue: Moves or places clues onto a location, investigator or card instead of discovering them (e.g. Vantage Point).
desc_tag_location_move_damage: Moves damage from you or your cards onto an enemy (e.g. Drain Essence).
desc_tag_location_move_enemy_control: Moves an enemy to a location of your choice, or controls where enemies move (e.g. Lure).
desc_tag_location_move_enemy_displace: Pushes an enemy away, moving it to a connecting location or swapping places with it (e.g. Bait and Switch).
desc_tag_location_move_enemy_to_you: Pulls an enemy from another location to your location (e.g. "Get over here!").
desc_tag_location_move_investigator_any: Moves an investigator you choose, not only yourself, to another location (e.g. Shortcut).
desc_tag_location_move_investigator_self: You move to another location through a card effect, often without spending a move action (e.g. Think on Your Feet).
desc_tag_location_move_investigator_perf: The investigator performing the skill test moves, so this skill can help a teammate reposition (e.g. Survival Instinct).
desc_tag_location_shroud_dependent: Uses a location's shroud value as a number, such as a difficulty, cost or condition (e.g. Lola Santiago).
desc_tag_location_shroud_reduction: Lowers a location's shroud, making it easier to investigate (e.g. Flashlight).
desc_tag_location_your_enemy: The effect targets an enemy at your location, whether or not it is engaged with you (e.g. Beat Cop).
desc_tag_location_your_investigator: The effect targets or helps an investigator at your location, including effects that reach any investigator anywhere (e.g. First Aid).
desc_tag_location_your_ally: The effect targets an Ally asset at your location, yours or another investigator's (e.g. Inspiring Presence).
desc_tag_skill_commit_skill_double_icon: A skill card with two or more icons of the same skill, or two or more wild icons (e.g. Overpower).
desc_tag_skill_commit_nonskill_lv0_wild_: A level 0 asset or event with a wild icon, so it doubles as a flexible commit to any skill test (e.g. Rabbit's Foot).
tag_skill_commit_nonskill_lv0_two_effect: Skill Commit/Non-Skill Lv0 Two Effective Icons
desc_tag_skill_commit_nonskill_lv0_two_e: A level 0 asset or event with two icons for the same skill (a wild counts), so it commits like a skill card (e.g. "Look what I found!").
desc_tag_skill_commit_no_commit_icons: An event with no skill icons at all, so it can never be committed to a skill test, only played (e.g. Lucky!).
desc_tag_timing_phase_mythos_begins: Triggers when the mythos phase begins.
desc_tag_timing_phase_mythos_place_doom: Triggers when doom is placed on the agenda during the mythos phase.
desc_tag_timing_phase_mythos_check_doom: Triggers when the doom threshold is checked, such as when the agenda would advance (e.g. Mystifying Song).
desc_tag_timing_phase_mythos_draw_encoun: Triggers at the mythos phase's "draw encounter cards" step, usually replacing your encounter draw (e.g. On the Hunt).
desc_tag_timing_phase_mythos_ends: Triggers at the end of the mythos phase (e.g. Dark Ritual).
desc_tag_timing_phase_investigation_begi: Triggers at the start of the investigation phase (e.g. Joe Diamond).
desc_tag_timing_phase_investigation_turn: Triggers when or after your turn begins (e.g. Leo Anderson).
desc_tag_timing_phase_investigation_take: Triggers after an action is performed, such as repeating or undoing it (e.g. Haste).
desc_tag_timing_phase_investigation_turn: Triggers when or after your turn ends (e.g. Peter Sylvestre).
desc_tag_timing_phase_investigation_ends: Triggers when the investigation phase ends (e.g. Ultimate Sacrifice).
desc_tag_timing_phase_enemy_begins: Triggers when the enemy phase begins (e.g. Infighting).
desc_tag_timing_phase_enemy_hunter_move: Triggers during the enemy phase step when unengaged hunter enemies move.
desc_tag_timing_phase_enemy_attacks: Triggers during the enemy phase step when engaged enemies attack.
desc_tag_timing_phase_enemy_ends: Triggers at the end of the enemy phase (e.g. Hiding Spot).
desc_tag_timing_phase_upkeep_begins: Triggers when the upkeep phase begins.
desc_tag_timing_phase_upkeep_reset_actio: Triggers at the upkeep phase step when investigators reset their actions.
desc_tag_timing_phase_upkeep_ready_cards: Triggers at the upkeep phase step when exhausted cards ready.
desc_tag_timing_phase_upkeep_draw_resour: Triggers at the upkeep phase step when each investigator draws 1 card and gains 1 resource.
desc_tag_timing_phase_upkeep_check_hand_: Triggers at the upkeep phase step when investigators check hand size and discard down to 8.
desc_tag_timing_phase_upkeep_ends: Triggers at the end of the upkeep phase, which is also the end of the round (e.g. Hired Muscle).
desc_compound_ally_healing: Heals an ally asset (damage or horror) — the keep-your-allies-alive package (First Aid, Emergency Aid).
desc_tag_cancel_use_instead: Ignore a card effect that forces you to use willpower in place of another skill (e.g. Empower Self).
desc_tag_commit_during_basic_action: Gains extra icons or text only when committed during a specific action, such as a basic fight, investigate, or evade (e.g. Sharp Vision).
desc_tag_control_transfer_asset: Move control of an asset between investigators: give it, take it, or play it under someone else's control (e.g. Teamwork).
desc_tag_deck_search_reaction: Triggers when this card is among the cards searched from your deck (e.g. Surprising Find).
desc_tag_gain_alert: Gives an enemy the alert keyword, so a failed evasion attempt against it provokes an attack (e.g. String Along).
desc_tag_play_area_play_ignoring_cost: Plays a card without paying its resource cost (e.g. Easy Mark).
desc_tag_remote_play_event: Play an event as if you were at another location, such as a connecting one (e.g. Luke Robinson).
desc_tag_slot_share: Several copies of this card fit together in a single slot (e.g. Empower Self).
desc_tag_timing_when_search_deck: Triggers when an investigator would search their deck or the encounter deck, improving the search (e.g. Mandy Thompson).
desc_tag_victory_display_add_encounter: Adds an encounter card, such as a defeated enemy or a passed treachery, to the victory display (e.g. The Eye of Truth).
desc_group_bonded: Bonded cards — set aside outside your deck and brought in by their partner card.
desc_tag_bonded_card: A bonded card: set aside outside your deck, brought in by its partner card, and set aside again instead of discarded (e.g. Soothing Melody).
desc_tag_bonded_fetch: Brings a card from your set-aside bonded cards into your hand, deck, or play (e.g. Hallowed Mirror); this is not a deck search.
desc_tag_commit_during_attack: Can only be committed to, or only gets its bonus during, a test made during an attack (e.g. Fighting Lessons).
desc_tag_commit_during_evade: Can only be committed to, or only gets its bonus during, a test made during an evasion attempt (e.g. Daring).
desc_tag_encounter_offload: Another investigator resolves an encounter card you would have drawn (e.g. "You handle this one!").
desc_tag_tank_move_damage_horror: Moves damage or horror already on player cards onto other player cards, rather than healing it (e.g. Solemn Vow).
desc_tag_timing_when_leaves_play: Triggers when a card leaves play (defeated, discarded or otherwise), usually the card itself (e.g. Brother Xavier).
desc_tag_action_take_immediate: Take an action right away, outside the normal action sequence (e.g. Swift Reflexes); extra actions to spend during your turn are Action/Additional.
desc_tag_condition_copies: Cares about multiple copies of a card, usually itself, whether in play, in hand, in your discard pile, or committed (e.g. Three Aces).
desc_tag_cost_discount_self: Reduces its own cost to play, usually offsetting a high printed cost (e.g. Extensive Research).
desc_tag_enemy_value_remaining_health: Cares about damage on an enemy or its remaining health, as a finisher that needs it low or a bonus that scales with it (e.g. Garrote Wire).
desc_tag_location_create_connection: Creates a connection between locations that aren't normally connected, letting investigators move between them (e.g. Open Gate).
desc_tag_location_ignore_effects: Ignores effects or keywords on your location that would trigger while you act there (e.g. Read the Signs).
desc_tag_slot_ignore: Lets certain assets take up none of the slots they normally would (e.g. Detective's Colt 1911s).
desc_tag_timing_after_draw_card: Triggers when or after you draw cards from your deck (e.g. Dream-Enhancing Serum); not encounter draws, nor a card reacting to being drawn itself.
desc_compound_slot_tech: Slot juggling — converting a slot’s type, copies sharing one slot, or a card ignoring its slot entirely (Abigail Foreman, Trigger Man).
desc_compound_victory_display: Banks victory points — adding itself (Delve Too Deep) or encounter cards (The Eye of Truth) to the victory display.
desc_tag_chaos_recycle_token: Return a revealed bless or curse token to the chaos bag after the test instead of to the token pool (e.g. Sacred Covenant).
desc_tag_chaos_spend_sealed: Release sealed chaos tokens, or return them to the token pool, to pay for or power an effect (e.g. Shield of Faith).
desc_tag_chaos_bag_count_condition: Only works or scales based on how many bless or curse tokens are in the chaos bag (e.g. The Stygian Eye).
desc_tag_commit_count_condition: Only works or scales based on how many cards you committed to the test (e.g. Sea Change Harpoon).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_offering: A fast ability that costs offerings (e.g. Wolf Mask).
desc_tag_uses_starting_leyline: Has a printed leyline pool, "Uses (X leylines)", moved onto the board to power its effects (e.g. Archive of Conduits).
desc_tag_uses_starting_durability: Has a printed durability pool, "Uses (X durability)", spent to boost the asset it is attached to (e.g. Jury-Rig).
desc_tag_uses_board_marker: Moves its tokens onto locations, enemies, or investigators as markers that power later effects there (e.g. Archive of Conduits).
desc_tag_cost_alternate_payment: Resources or other tokens on this card can be spent to pay for cards with certain traits (e.g. Prophetic).
desc_tag_trait_support_fortune: Pays for or boosts Fortune cards (e.g. Prophetic).
desc_tag_trait_support_charm: Finds, plays or pays for Charm assets (e.g. Mirror Form).
desc_tag_trait_support_tool: Discounts, boosts or rewards controlling Tool assets (e.g. Wilson Richards).
desc_tag_skill_value_fail_by_or_more: Triggers when you fail a skill test by a set amount or more (e.g. Precious Memento).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_supply: A reaction that costs supplies (e.g. Bandages).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_durability: A fast ability that costs durability (e.g. Jury-Rig).
desc_tag_customizable: Comes with an upgrade sheet: spend experience to check boxes and unlock new abilities (e.g. Runic Axe).
desc_group_customizable: Customizable cards with an upgrade sheet.
desc_tag_cost_play_spend_action: As an additional cost to play it, spend one or more actions on top of its resource cost (e.g. Bank Job).
desc_tag_enemy_value_health: Uses an enemy's printed health as a number, such as a reward for defeating it or a test's difficulty (e.g. Ancestral Token).
desc_tag_trait_support_talent: Plays Talent assets at a discount or cashes them in for resources (e.g. the parallel Jenny Barnes).
desc_tag_doom_move: Moves doom from one card to another, rather than removing it or placing new doom (e.g. Sin-Eater).
desc_tag_test_difficulty_increase: Raises a skill test's difficulty, usually as a cost or drawback (e.g. Double or Nothing).
desc_tag_test_difficulty_condition: Only works when the test's difficulty meets a condition, such as being higher than your base skill value (e.g. Rise to the Occasion).
desc_tag_timing_after_seal_cancel_ignore: Triggers after you seal, cancel or ignore a chaos token, or checks whether you did so this round (e.g. Oculus Mortuum).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_ammo: A reaction that costs ammo, such as a counter-shot or follow-up attack (e.g. Service Revolver).
desc_tag_hand_size_max_decrease: Reduces your maximum hand size, forcing more discards in the upkeep phase: a drawback (e.g. Patrice Hathaway).
desc_compound_testless_damage: Deals damage without a skill test — at your or a connecting location, to the attacking or engaged enemy, by turning an enemy’s attack on another enemy, or by moving your damage onto an enemy.
desc_compound_willpower_boost: Raises willpower — in a test, passively, or for a duration.
desc_compound_skill_value_boost: Stat-agnostic "+N skill value" or "+N to each skill" boosts (Lucky!, Well Prepared, the Edge of the Earth wallets).
desc_tag_damage_redirect_own_attack: Moves your own attack's damage onto a different enemy (e.g. Oops!); an enemy's attack turned on another enemy is Damage/Redirect Attack.
desc_tag_chaos_seal_token_plus_1: Seal a +1 token, taking it out of the chaos bag (e.g. Crystalline Elder Sign).
desc_tag_clue_additional_other_location: On a successful investigation, discover clues at another location, as well as or instead of the normal clue (e.g. Seeking Answers).
desc_tag_encounter_blank_text: Treat an enemy's or treachery's text box as blank, removing its abilities and keywords but not its traits (e.g. Mind Wipe).
desc_tag_enemy_target_attacking: A counterattack: your attack targets the enemy that attacked you (e.g. Counterpunch).
desc_tag_skill_value_margin_adjust: Shifts or sets how much a skill test succeeds or fails by, setting up exact-margin payoffs (e.g. Steady-Handed).
desc_tag_stats_mod_pump_uses: Spend any number of uses from the card (ammo, charges, secrets or offerings) for a bigger bonus (e.g. M1918 BAR).
desc_tag_testless_move_enemy: Move an enemy away from you without a test (e.g. Warning Shot).
desc_tag_timing_when_enemy_enters_locati: Triggers when an enemy enters a location by moving or spawning, usually the location this card is attached to (e.g. Snare Trap).
desc_compound_seal: The Seal keyword and its relatives — seal chaos tokens on a card, spend or release them, or resolve a sealed token instead of a revealed one.
desc_compound_doom_control: Keeps doom from advancing the agenda — remove it, move it, or stop it counting or being placed (Mystifying Song, Moonlight Ritual).
